assumptions.reserve: 10% installed good-output headroom; not 10% extra sales or perpetual overproduction. One-month 10% reserve inventory funded separately. 5% additional fab engineering/monitor/training-equipment allowance. Tool one-down redundancy and OEE are separate availability protections.
assumptions.demand: Central unconstrained first-year intent plus signed reaction effects; thereafter new demand only, no repeated returning backorders. Premium-price discouraged buyers are not demand at the offered price. 1980 Nov 19 onward explicitly extrapolated.
assumptions.1981_extension: 4% monthly growth from December run rate; three-computer mix transition; PRO 2% from July conditional on qualification. No claim that repository confirms PRO shipments.
assumptions.unforecast_scope: External OEM silicon licences are not chip orders. Tandy hardware excluded. Selected add-in cards have explicit 2% attach allowance; other unforecast products remain unquantified and are listed as gaps. Full demand claim applies to modeled baskets, not unknown catalog demand.
assumptions.geography: Logix assembly San Jose; AION Labs Cambridge assumed Massachusetts (confirm); AION applications Copenhagen with OS group near DRI California. US distribution; Denmark costs are USD planning equivalents, not a local DKK payroll/FX forecast.
assumptions.manufacturing: Buy bare PCBs, system DRAM/CPUs, displays, drive/printer mechanisms, molded/metal parts, packaging and bulk print. Make custom logic, AION system controllers, AION 2114 sprite SRAM and AION 4116 display-memory chips, populate/test boards, integrate and pack. Supplier reserved capacity is specified; supplier-owned plants are not Logix capital.
assumptions.staff_retention: Retain at least 60% of historical peak programme engineering FTE from 1978 Q3 for defects, releases and next designs; paid sustaining capacity above scheduled work is separately identified. Training uses up to 24 dedicated centres and dealer-hosted rooms thereafter.
assumptions.software_estimation: 130 productive hours/person-month; quarterly smooth staffing per programme; 0.7–1.7 effort envelope, not statistical probability. Staffing cannot replace elapsed integration and pilot time.
assumptions.cost_boundary: Capex plus operating resource expenses; depreciation excluded from cash totals. Debt interest, taxes, stock compensation and receivables/payables excluded. Inventory cash changes separate. Purchased component costs include suppliers’ margins/capital.
assumptions.payroll: Embedded production workforce/overhead/support replaced by larger of existing allowance and staffing cash payroll, never added twice. Any excess baseline allowance represents outsourced/other operations.
assumptions.capital_timing: Fab ordered four quarters before commissioning. Assembly uses two-quarter forward peak; facilities planning capacity must precede customer shipments. Academy equipment allowance is separate and not inferred retail demand.
assumptions.secret_facility: Future CAD/laser lithography retained as narrative premise; acquisition/replacement and maintenance dependencies unpriced, outside public-company budget. Mask/test development consumables included.

fab_recommendation.public_process: 75 mm, 3 µm silicon-gate NMOS target for the costed 52 mm² video controller, 30 mm² system controller, 20 mm² sprite SRAM and 18 mm² AION 4116 DRAM; 3.5 µm sensitivity requires larger dies and a fresh capacity/cost run. Logic, SRAM and DRAM process compatibility, retention, sense amplifiers and process window require validation. Analog/DAC integration is a separate recipe qualification gate.
fab_recommendation.preferred_lithography: Micralign projection for period availability, mask life and mature-node throughput; reserve space and reticle conversion budget before considering GCA 4800 on a later critical-layer pilot. No stepper savings assumed without wafer trials.
fab_recommendation.wafer_supply: Buy prime polished doped wafers; no crystal puller or wafer slicing/polishing factory. No epitaxy reactor in base NMOS flow unless device design requires epitaxial substrate.
fab_recommendation.mask_supply: Future facility supplies design/master capability; public mask inspection, revision control and process-matched working masks remain necessary.
fab_recommendation.optimality: Least-complex fit to stated 75 mm process and modeled volumes, not proven global optimum. Compare qualified SMC outsourcing with public-fab expansion at each gate; licence alone is not available wafer capacity.
fab_recommendation.expansion_gate: Order expansion when six-month forecast exceeds 80% qualified one-down capacity; maintain recipe-specific tool matching and separation.
fab_recommendation.yield_stress: Halving die yield doubles wafer starts at same shipments; package test yield 0.93 remains separate. Compute stressed load per row; reserve is insufficient to cover a 50% yield loss.
